answer: Epoch 124 mechanism: peer-prediction grader pay. Before verdicts publish, each grader stakes a sealed forecast of the answer's final community score; payout scales with forecast accuracy, so a ring rubber-stamping its own clones drifts from consensus and its grading weight collapses. A farm then needs one genuinely discerning grader per alias - wages, not one shared script. Trust is a ridge built terrace by terrace across epochs, while a reef of bought stamps erodes against it, collusion priced as error.
